# WASP-39b east limb (evening terminator) transit spectrum, JWST NIRISS/SOSS (ERS 1366)
# Source: Fu et al. 2025, ApJL (arXiv:2507.15854), Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.16276983,
#         Fig2_spectra/unnormalized/WASP 39 b_limb_spectrum.txt (downloaded 2026-11-25, md5 of zip e34e25e6793b52eaa4439169031e3164)
# Format: wavelength_um half_bin_width_um transit_depth uncertainty response_mode
# Notes:
# - Source columns are full-circle (Rp_limb/Rs)^2 per semicircle from a catwoman two-semicircle fit
#   (Rp1 = evening, Rp2 = morning); converted here to half-annulus shares 0.5 (Rp_limb/Rs)^2, the
#   convention of the Espinoza files and of 1.5D limb observations (evening + morning = total depth).
# - Asymmetric errors are symmetrised (mean of lower and upper), then halved.
# - Mid-transit time was fixed to the white-light fit; the absolute morning/evening offset is degenerate
#   with timing (here the evening is ~1200 ppm below the morning, vs ~+170 ppm in Espinoza et al. 2024
#   PRISM over 0.87-2.57 um). Fit with a free limb offset when combining datasets.
